name: DIABLO
description: Diablo is a high-action Five Card Draw poker variant characterized by three primary mechanics: Deuces are wild, players are restricted to drawing a maximum of two cards, and most importantly, if the player who opens the betting fails to win the pot, they must 'match the pot' to create a new one for the next deal.

content.text: Diablo is a high-action Five Card Draw poker variant characterized by three primary mechanics: Deuces are wild, players are restricted to drawing a maximum of two cards, and most importantly, if the player who opens the betting fails to win the pot, they must 'match the pot' to create a new one for the next deal.
A staple of 'Dealer's Choice' home games in the United States. Its exact origin is undocumented, but it belongs to the mid-20th century tradition of 'action-inducing' poker variants.
2-6 players (Best with 5-6 to ensure enough competition for the opener).
Standard 52-card deck. All four 2s are wild.
Each player is dealt 5 cards face down. In some variants, the first replacement card drawn later is dealt face up, though standard Diablo keeps all cards face down (verify with house rules).

items.text: Capped Diablo: To prevent bankrupting players, the amount the opener must match is capped at a fixed limit (e.g., 20 big blinds).
Exposed Diablo: The first card drawn by each player is dealt face up, providing more information to the table.
